news.title: No major? No problem. These students found their way at UNI
news.summary_en: It's totally OK to not have your major figured out when you first get to college. In fact, it's pretty common. Check out these students' experiences in UNI's Exploratory Program.

news.title: At 30, a career change leads to new possibilities at UNI
news.summary_en: At 30, Austin Anderson traded engineering for accounting, finding the support, connections and opportunities at UNI to launch a new chapter in his career.
